title: Generate consistent characters/objects by first prompting Seedance to create…
content:
Generate consistent characters/objects by first prompting Seedance to create “reference sheets” on a seamless neutral grey studio background with two views (dominant full-body on the left + tight close-up on the right), and include “no text, no labels, no graphics” to keep them clean for reuse.

For a cohesive period look across all assets, repeat the same film/format style block in every prompt (e.g., 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette).

When building a longer video in Seedance 2.5, translate the full scene prompt into Chinese to avoid the character limit.

Use Seedance’s active reference tags (@image1, @image2, etc.) and add “100% matches the reference” locks for each subject (characters, cat, car, location, title card) to enforce identity and continuity.

Write a timed multishot prompt with explicit HARD CUT timestamps and per-shot lens/FOV specs (e.g., 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU) to control shot progression and framing.

Lock spatial continuity by explicitly stating left/right positions and constraints (e.g., left-hand drive steering wheel on the LEFT; driver at camera-left; passenger at camera-right; cat under grandmother’s right arm in every shot) and repeating them in a “POSITIVE LOCKS” section.

Specify camera movement with measurable speeds and behaviors (e.g., crane descends at 12 km/h, dolly at 20 km/h, push-ins at 3 km/h, handheld 1–2 cm breathing tremor, focus pulled by hand settling after each cut) to stabilize motion style.

Force lighting consistency by stating sun direction and white balance (e.g., low golden sun from camera-left, WB 5600K held constant) and reiterating it as a lock across shots.

To ensure exact on-screen text, provide a dedicated title-card prompt with “Centred text reading exactly: …”, “Perfectly correct spelling”, and “No other text/logos/borders,” then time its appearance precisely (e.g., appears from 28.0s onward).

Set output explicitly (1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback) to match intended delivery and motion cadence.

es.content:
Genera personajes/objetos consistentes pidiéndole primero a Seedance que cree “reference sheets” sobre un fondo de estudio gris neutro, uniforme y sin costuras, con dos vistas (plano general de cuerpo entero dominante a la izquierda + primerísimo primer plano a la derecha), e incluye “no text, no labels, no graphics” para mantenerlos limpios y reutilizables.

Para lograr un aspecto de época coherente en todos los assets, repite el mismo bloque de estilo de película/formato en cada prompt (por ejemplo, 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette).

Al construir un video más largo en Seedance 2.5, traduce el prompt completo de la escena al chino para evitar el límite de caracteres.

Usa las etiquetas de referencia activas de Seedance (@image1, @image2, etc.) y añade bloqueos de “100% matches the reference” para cada sujeto (characters, cat, car, location, title card) para imponer identidad y continuidad.

Escribe un prompt multishot con tiempo definido, con timestamps explícitos de HARD CUT y especificaciones de lente/FOV por plano (por ejemplo, 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU) para controlar la progresión de los planos y el encuadre.

Bloquea la continuidad espacial indicando explícitamente las posiciones izquierda/derecha y las restricciones (por ejemplo, volante de conducción a la izquierda; driver at camera-left; passenger at camera-right; cat under grandmother’s right arm in every shot) y repitiéndolas en una sección “POSITIVE LOCKS”.

Especifica el movimiento de cámara con velocidades y comportamientos medibles (por ejemplo, crane desciende a 12 km/h, dolly a 20 km/h, push-ins a 3 km/h, handheld con temblor de respiración de 1–2 cm, focus pulled by hand settling after each cut) para estabilizar el estilo de movimiento.

Fuerza la coherencia de la iluminación indicando la dirección del sol y el balance de blancos (por ejemplo, low golden sun from camera-left, WB 5600K held constant) y reiterándolo como un lock a lo largo de los planos.

Para asegurar texto exacto en pantalla, proporciona un prompt dedicado para la tarjeta de título con “Centred text reading exactly: …”, “Perfectly correct spelling”, y “No other text/logos/borders,” y luego cronometra su aparición con precisión (por ejemplo, appears from 28.0s onward).

Define explícitamente la salida (1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback) para que coincida con la entrega prevista y la cadencia de movimiento.

fr.content:
Générez des personnages/objets cohérents en demandant d’abord à Seedance de créer des « reference sheets » sur un fond de studio gris neutre, uniforme et sans raccord, avec deux vues (vue principale en pied à gauche + gros plan serré à droite), et incluez « no text, no labels, no graphics » pour les garder propres et réutilisables.

Pour obtenir un rendu d’époque cohérent sur tous les assets, répétez le même bloc de style film/format dans chaque prompt (par ex. 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette).

Lors de la création d’une vidéo plus longue dans Seedance 2.5, traduisez le prompt complet de la scène en chinois afin d’éviter la limite de caractères.

Utilisez les tags de référence actifs de Seedance (@image1, @image2, etc.) et ajoutez des verrous « 100% matches the reference » pour chaque sujet (personnages, chat, voiture, lieu, title card) afin de garantir l’identité et la continuité.

Rédigez un prompt multishot chronométré avec des timestamps explicites de HARD CUT et des spécifications de lentille/FOV par plan (par ex. 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU) pour contrôler la progression des plans et le cadrage.

Verrouillez la continuité spatiale en indiquant explicitement les positions gauche/droite et les contraintes (par ex. volant à gauche pour conduite à gauche ; conducteur côté caméra gauche ; passager côté caméra droite ; chat sous le bras droit de la grand-mère dans chaque plan) et en les répétant dans une section « POSITIVE LOCKS ».

Précisez le mouvement de caméra avec des vitesses et comportements mesurables (par ex. grue qui descend à 12 km/h, travelling à 20 km/h, push-ins à 3 km/h, tremblement handheld de 1–2 cm, mise au point refaite à la main et se stabilisant après chaque cut) pour stabiliser le style de mouvement.

Forcez la cohérence de l’éclairage en indiquant la direction du soleil et la balance des blancs (par ex. soleil bas et doré venant de la gauche caméra, WB 5600K maintenue constante) et en la réitérant comme verrou sur l’ensemble des plans.

Pour garantir un texte à l’écran exact, fournissez un prompt dédié pour la title card avec « Centred text reading exactly: … », « Perfectly correct spelling », et « No other text/logos/borders, » puis synchronisez précisément son apparition (par ex. apparaît à partir de 28.0s).

Définissez explicitement la sortie (1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback) afin de correspondre au rendu et au rythme de mouvement souhaités.

ja.content:
一貫したキャラクター／オブジェクトを生成するには、まず Seedance に「reference sheets」を作成させます。シームレスなニュートラルグレーのスタジオ背景に、2つのビュー（左に主役の全身、右にタイトなクローズアップ）を配置し、再利用時にきれいな状態を保てるように “no text, no labels, no graphics” を含めます。

すべての素材で統一感のある時代感を出すには、各プロンプトで同じ film/format style ブロックを繰り返します（例: 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette）。

Seedance 2.5 で長尺動画を作る場合は、文字数制限を避けるために、シーン全体のプロンプトを中国語に翻訳します。

Seedance の active reference tags（@image1、@image2 など）を使い、各被写体（characters, cat, car, location, title card）ごとに “100% matches the reference” のロックを追加して、アイデンティティと連続性を強制します。

タイム指定付きの multishot プロンプトを書き、明確な HARD CUT のタイムスタンプと、各ショットごとの lens/FOV 仕様（例: 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU）を入れて、ショットの進行とフレーミングを制御します。

空間的な連続性は、左右の位置関係と制約を明示することで固定します（例: left-hand drive steering wheel on the LEFT; driver at camera-left; passenger at camera-right; cat under grandmother’s right arm in every shot）。これらは “POSITIVE LOCKS” セクションでも繰り返します。

カメラの動きは、測定可能な速度と挙動で指定して安定させます（例: crane descends at 12 km/h, dolly at 20 km/h, push-ins at 3 km/h, handheld 1–2 cm breathing tremor, focus pulled by hand settling after each cut）。

ライティングの一貫性は、太陽の方向とホワイトバランスを明記して固定します（例: low golden sun from camera-left, WB 5600K held constant）。これもショット全体のロックとして繰り返します。

画面上の文字を正確にするには、専用の title-card プロンプトを用意し、“Centred text reading exactly: …”, “Perfectly correct spelling”, “No other text/logos/borders,” を含め、その表示タイミングを正確に指定します（例: appears from 28.0s onward）。

出力設定は明示的に指定します（1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback）ことで、意図した納品形式とモーションのテンポに合わせます。

ko.content:
일관된 캐릭터/오브젝트를 생성하려면 먼저 Seedance에 매끄러운 중성 회색 스튜디오 배경 위에서 두 가지 뷰(왼쪽에 지배적인 전신 + 오른쪽에 타이트한 클로즈업)로 “reference sheets”를 만들도록 프롬프트하고, 재사용 시 깔끔하게 유지되도록 “no text, no labels, no graphics”를 포함하세요.

모든 에셋에서 통일감 있는 시대적 분위기를 만들려면, 모든 프롬프트에 동일한 film/format 스타일 블록을 반복하세요(예: 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette).

Seedance 2.5에서 더 긴 비디오를 만들 때는, 캐릭터 제한을 피하기 위해 전체 장면 프롬프트를 중국어로 번역하세요.

Seedance의 active reference tags(@image1, @image2 등)를 사용하고, 각 주제(캐릭터, 고양이, 자동차, 장소, 타이틀 카드)에 대해 “100% matches the reference” locks를 추가하여 정체성과 연속성을 강제하세요.

명시적인 HARD CUT 타임스탬프와 샷별 렌즈/FOV 사양(예: 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU)을 포함한 timed multishot prompt를 작성하여 샷 진행과 구도를 제어하세요.

왼쪽/오른쪽 위치와 제약을 명시적으로 적어 공간적 연속성을 고정하세요(예: 왼쪽 운전석 스티어링 휠은 LEFT에 위치; 운전자는 camera-left; 동승자는 camera-right; 모든 샷에서 고양이는 할머니의 오른팔 아래에 있음) 그리고 이를 “POSITIVE LOCKS” 섹션에 반복하세요.

측정 가능한 속도와 동작으로 카메라 움직임을 지정하여 모션 스타일을 안정화하세요(예: crane descends at 12 km/h, dolly at 20 km/h, push-ins at 3 km/h, handheld 1–2 cm breathing tremor, focus pulled by hand settling after each cut).

태양 방향과 화이트 밸런스를 명시하여 조명 일관성을 강제하세요(예: low golden sun from camera-left, WB 5600K held constant) 그리고 이를 샷 전반의 lock으로 반복하세요.

정확한 화면 텍스트를 보장하려면, 전용 타이틀 카드 프롬프트를 제공하고 “Centred text reading exactly: …”, “Perfectly correct spelling”, “No other text/logos/borders,”를 포함한 뒤, 등장 시점을 정확히 지정하세요(예: appears from 28.0s onward).

의도한 출력과 모션 리듬에 맞추기 위해 출력 설정을 명시적으로 지정하세요(1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback).

pt.content:
Gere personagens/objetos consistentes começando por pedir ao Seedance que crie “reference sheets” em um fundo de estúdio cinza neutro, contínuo e sem emendas, com duas vistas (corpo inteiro dominante à esquerda + close-up fechado à direita), e inclua “no text, no labels, no graphics” para mantê-los limpos para reutilização.

Para um visual de época coeso em todos os assets, repita o mesmo bloco de estilo de filme/formato em cada prompt (por exemplo, 1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette).

Ao construir um vídeo mais longo no Seedance 2.5, traduza o prompt completo da cena para o chinês para evitar o limite de caracteres.

Use as active reference tags do Seedance (@image1, @image2, etc.) e adicione travas “100% matches the reference” para cada sujeito (personagens, gato, carro, local, title card) para reforçar identidade e continuidade.

Escreva um prompt multishot com tempo definido, com timestamps explícitos de HARD CUT e especificações de lente/FOV por tomada (por exemplo, 84° EWS, 63° WS, 29° MCU, 18° CU, 12° ECU) para controlar a progressão dos planos e o enquadramento.

Trave a continuidade espacial declarando explicitamente posições e restrições de esquerda/direita (por exemplo, volante com direção à esquerda no LADO ESQUERDO; motorista à esquerda da câmera; passageiro à direita da câmera; gato sob o braço direito da avó em todas as tomadas) e repetindo isso em uma seção “POSITIVE LOCKS”.

Especifique o movimento de câmera com velocidades e comportamentos mensuráveis (por exemplo, crane desce a 12 km/h, dolly a 20 km/h, push-ins a 3 km/h, handheld com tremor de respiração de 1–2 cm, foco puxado à mão se estabilizando após cada corte) para estabilizar o estilo de movimento.

Force a consistência da iluminação declarando a direção do sol e o white balance (por exemplo, sol baixo e dourado vindo da esquerda da câmera, WB 5600K mantido constante) e reiterando isso como uma trava entre as tomadas.

Para garantir texto exato na tela, forneça um prompt dedicado para o title card com “Centred text reading exactly: …”, “Perfectly correct spelling” e “No other text/logos/borders”, e então cronometre sua aparição com precisão (por exemplo, aparece a partir de 28.0s).

Defina explicitamente a saída (1080p, 16:9, 24 fps real-time playback) para corresponder à entrega pretendida e à cadência de movimento.

zh.content:
通过先提示 Seedance 在无缝的中性灰色工作室背景上创建“reference sheets”来生成一致的角色/物体，画面包含两个视图（左侧为主的全身照 + 右侧的特写），并加入“no text, no labels, no graphics”以保持画面干净，便于重复使用。

为了让所有素材呈现统一的时代感，在每个 prompt 中重复相同的 film/format style block（例如：1962 Eastman Color film still, Super Panavision 70, coarse film grain, soft halation, no digital sharpness, consistent palette）。

在使用 Seedance 2.5 制作更长视频时，将完整的场景 prompt 翻译成中文，以避免字符限制。

使用 Seedance 的 active reference tags（@image1、@image2 等），并为每个主体（角色、猫、汽车、地点、标题卡）添加“100% matches the reference”锁定，以强化身份一致性和连续性。

编写带时间标记的 multishot prompt，明确标注 HARD CUT 时间点以及每个镜头的镜头焦段/FOV 规格（例如 84° EWS、63° WS、29° MCU、18° CU、12° ECU），以控制镜头推进和构图。

通过明确说明左右位置和限制来锁定空间连续性（例如：左舵车方向盘在左侧；司机在画面左侧；乘客在画面右侧；每个镜头里猫都在祖母的右臂下方），并在 “POSITIVE LOCKS” 部分重复这些设定。

通过指定可测量的摄像机运动速度和行为来说明镜头运动（例如：crane 以 12 km/h 下降，dolly 以 20 km/h 移动，push-in 以 3 km/h 推进，handheld 具有 1–2 cm 的呼吸式抖动，每次 cut 后由手动对焦并在镜头稳定后完成），以稳定运动风格。

通过说明太阳方向和白平衡来强制统一光线（例如：低位金色阳光从画面左侧照入，WB 5600K 保持不变），并将其作为跨镜头锁定条件反复强调。

为确保屏幕文字完全准确，提供专门的 title-card prompt，使用“Centred text reading exactly: …”、“Perfectly correct spelling”和“No other text/logos/borders”，然后精确设定其出现时间（例如：从 28.0s 开始出现）。

明确设置输出参数（1080p、16:9、24 fps real-time playback），以匹配预期的交付格式和运动节奏。
